source.author: herio
source.note: Substitutes for plan row #146 (Quaternius Shoji Wall, poly.pizza static GLB, blocked by its Cloudflare challenge). herio's 'japanese school' on OpenGameArt is a small classroom wall kit in one .blend (opened with auto-run off). Kept: `windoWall inside`, a wall section with a 5 x 5 wooden lattice over paper panes above a wooden wainscot, with a dark header beam and baseboard. Dropped by object name: `door`, `door wall`, `door wall.001`, `floor`, `roof`, `wallA`, `wallB`, `colum` (a 5 cm post that adds nothing) and `windoWall inside.001` (a different variant: open lattice sashes with no paper, which read as holes beside the closed bay). The source textures are Textures.com photos (shipped in the zip under their own terms); they are fetched only to flatten each material into flat colours (maxColors 3) and no image reaches model.glb. Size: the source bay is 1.0 x 2.1 units; scaled to 2.6 m tall (a room's wall height, header top) it is 1.24 m wide and 0.14 m deep, one window bay; tile it side by side for a longer wall (bays meet at x = +-0.62 m). Room side (lattice in front of the paper) faces +Z after a 180 degree yaw; bottom on y = 0. From behind (-Z) it reads as a dark wall with one plain paper panel (the paper is a single sheet behind the lattice), so it works from both sides; every role is double-sided because the panes and frame are one-sided sheets. Look (noon): the whole wooden frame, lattice and wainscot (source `oldWood`, one material, so lattice and surround cannot be told apart) dark brown over ink-brown shade; header beam and baseboard (`WoodPlanksOld`) near-black; paper practical white over paper shade. There is no plaster on this piece: the source's wall is all wood. Thresholds 0 for every role so faces toward the room are lit under the high side light. Faceted (smooth false). A thin sliver at the bottom of the lower-left pane is in the source geometry. Static, no clips.
source.changes: kept one wall object of the kit (`windoWall inside`) and dropped the rest; replaced the photo textures with flat colours; rescaled to 2.6 m, turned 180 degrees, recentred; recoloured to the noon script; meshopt-compressed GLB
